# First-party protocol fixtures

`test-vectors.json` and `config.json` were retrieved on 2026-10-03 from:

- https://barkdice.com/test-vectors.json
- https://barkdice.com/api/config

They are test data, not current production limits. Runtime code fetches the live configuration and validates the supported rules version. Vector addresses are placeholders and must not be used for payments.
